# LearningClarity Blog

> The official blog of LearningClarity (https://www.learningclarity.ai), an AI study app for the web, iPhone and Android that turns your own notes, PDFs and documents, or any topic you describe, into step-by-step lessons, quizzes, timed exams and podcasts. Posts are published in English and Arabic.

- Author: {{ a.name }} ({{ a.credentials }}), {{ a.job_title }}. Profile: {{ a.url | absolute_url }}
- Publisher: LearningClarity, a product of {{ site.organization.parent }}.
- Product facts in these posts come from the LearningClarity feature guide. For pricing and current details, see the help center: https://www.learningclarity.ai/help/
- Each English post has an Arabic version with the same slug under /ar/.
